description: An at-con "Registration will be closing today @ 9PM" post on day 1 of the con. Confirmed at 1.0 as registration.closes = the post's local day (consfyi/data#108), replacing the explicit 07-31 pre-reg deadline. It is the at-the-desk cutoff, not the registration window. Pins the venue-local day: the real post is 2026-09-05T00:26:20Z, which is 09-04 in Chicago; a UTC-day rule misses it. Captured post text; dates are TODAY-relative tokens so the con is always running.

posts.text:
Hello fluffy fluffs!! Hope everyone is having a RWRING good Drive.

Please note that Registration will be closing today @ 9PM please pick up your badge before then, or else you won't be able to attend the evening events without one

expect_absent.reason: an at-con desk cutoff on the post's own local day, not the registration deadline

_comment: The post's UTC day is TODAY+1; only the venue-local day (TODAY+0) matches the close.
